concept: Escanor is adapted as a daytime Rhitta wielder whose growing physical power is represented by increasingly forceful axe strikes, controlled heat, and a brief peak-power boost. Sunshine belongs to Escanor, but its power returned to Mael during the New Holy War and was later given back for the Demon King battle; this proposal does not claim it is always available or that a clock is implemented.

signature.name: Sunshine
signature.adaptation: Escanor's strength, size, and speed rise during the day and reach a brief noon peak. The unit represents that escalation through purchases and one temporary self-boost, not a day-and-night cycle, a real-time clock, or invulnerability.

repertoire.name: Rhitta
repertoire.limitation: Escanor's axe is heavy and off-balance; its daytime use and controlled heat release are not represented as a time-of-day rule or a separate weapon-recall action.

effects.effect: Escanor wields the heavy, head-weighted axe in daytime and can strike with it.
effects.reason: The automatic attack is a blunt Rhitta strike; purchases increase its hit strength.

effects.effect: Escanor can store heat in Rhitta and release it precisely on command.
effects.reason: The bottom path adapts controlled heat as a permanent burn on qualifying axe hits; the middle path's boost represents a temporary increase to the attack, not a separate stored-heat release.

effects.effect: Escanor's magic-imbued Rhitta slashes burn foes.
effects.reason: The bottom path adds a bounded burn status to the automatic attack.

repertoire.name: Sunshine
repertoire.limitation: The actual daily cycle, changing personality and appearance, human bodily damage, and The One's exact one-minute noon condition are not implemented.

effects.effect: Sunshine increases Escanor's physical power and size during the day and peaks at noon.
effects.reason: Permanent purchases represent escalating strength and speed; the middle-path boost temporarily amplifies the purchased attack. The literal time cycle and size change are not implemented.

effects.effect: The One is Escanor's peak form and lasts for one minute.
effects.reason: The middle-path boost is a temporary peak-power approximation. Its duration and cooldown are engine-defined rather than canon timing.

repertoire.name: Super Slash
repertoire.limitation: The described downward axe slash and its distant felt impact are represented as an ordinary hit with increased capacity, not as a separate delivery or a measured shockwave.

effects.effect: Escanor delivers a powerful downward axe slash that causes considerable damage felt several meters away.
effects.reason: The top path strengthens the hit and lets it pass through a limited number of distinct targets; no independent shockwave is claimed.

repertoire.name: Cruel Sun
repertoire.limitation: The miniature sun's independent movement and hand-gesture control are not represented as a separate projectile or delivery.

effects.effect: Escanor creates a miniature sun whose heat melts nearby armor, controls it with gestures, and strikes opponents with it as it grows.
effects.reason: The bottom path adapts nearby impact coverage as splash on the existing axe attack; its heat is not adapted as burn by a purchase named Cruel Sun, and it does not create or steer a miniature sun.

repertoire.name: Crazy Prominence
repertoire.limitation: The source describes multiple miniature suns exploding on impact; the engine's attack does not support independent spawned suns or their separate flight paths.

effects.effect: Escanor produces many miniature suns from his body that explode on impact.
effects.reason: The bottom capstone uses splash on the existing attack to represent an impact affecting nearby enemies. The multiple suns and independent deliveries are omitted.

repertoire.name: The One
repertoire.limitation: The exact noon trigger, one-minute duration, and claim of invincibility are not represented.

effects.effect: At noon Escanor becomes a brief peak form with greatly increased power.
effects.reason: The middle path's temporary boost represents a brief peak in the strength and speed of the attack, without asserting invulnerability or a noon trigger.

base.name: Daytime Rhitta Strike
base.behavior: At 0-0-0, Escanor swings Rhitta at one chosen primary enemy in range for a blunt normal-damage hit. The attack has one projectile and pierce 2, so it can hit at most two distinct enemies along its clear attack path, including the primary; it does not hit an enemy twice in one attack. There is no splash, status, bonus damage, Camo detection, or secondary targeting.

path1.name: Super Slash
path1.buyFor: Choose this path when enemies line up for a forceful axe stroke and a limited number of targets can be reached along the same attack path.
path1.weakness: The attack still needs a clear path and reaches only its own range; extra pierce does not create area damage or reach enemies outside the attack path.

milestones.tier1: 1-x-x increases the damage of each ordinary Rhitta hit against its selected primary and any enemy reached by its existing pierce.
milestones.tier2: 2-x-x further increases the damage of each ordinary Rhitta hit, keeping the same blunt delivery and target capacity.
milestones.tier3: 3-x-x adapts Super Slash as a heavier downward Rhitta strike that deals more damage and passes through more distinct enemies on the same clear attack path; it does not create a separate shockwave.
milestones.tier4: 4-x-x makes each Super Slash heavier and able to reach more distinct enemies, but Escanor's slower recovery reduces the ordinary attack rate.
milestones.tier5: 5-x-x adds a brief knockback to enemies hit by the heavy Super Slash when they are eligible for knockback, while increasing its damage; the hit does not push Blimps or Bosses.

path1.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase adds bounded displacement to the path's heavy strike, rather than only increasing its numbers. A concentrated upgrade gives the one placed capstone this extra control, while copies of the fourth purchase only provide slower, high-capacity hits.

crosspaths.contribution: Proposed early purchases: x-1-x represents Sunshine's rising physical speed by increasing the ordinary Rhitta attack rate without changing its delivery. x-2-x further increases the ordinary attack rate as Sunshine's power rises, retaining the same single-projectile Rhitta strike.

Proposed early purchases: x-x-1 increases the range of Escanor's ordinary Rhitta attack without changing its delivery or target capacity. x-x-2 further increases ordinary attack range while keeping the same single-targeting choice and attack delivery.

path1.referenceExample: The Profile's scale references inform this proposal; the supplied Definition alone authorizes mechanics.

path2.name: Sunshine Peak
path2.buyFor: Choose this path when a short, player-triggered attack surge is more useful than permanent area coverage or greater target capacity.
path2.weakness: The boost is temporary and does not shorten its cooldown when ordinary attacks become faster; the path does not reproduce The One's exact noon trigger, one-minute duration, or invulnerability.

milestones.tier1: x-1-x represents Sunshine's rising physical speed by increasing the ordinary Rhitta attack rate without changing its delivery.
milestones.tier2: x-2-x further increases the ordinary attack rate as Sunshine's power rises, retaining the same single-projectile Rhitta strike.
milestones.tier3: x-3-x adds permanent damage to the faster ordinary attack, representing Sunshine's increased physical strength while preserving its existing delivery and capacity.
milestones.tier4: x-4-x unlocks one manual boost of Escanor's purchased Rhitta attack; while it runs, the same attack deals more damage and attacks faster, then returns to its ordinary rate and damage when the engine-defined active window ends.
milestones.tier5: x-5-x modifies the same manual boost to strengthen its damage and rate and adds a bounded follow-up from each boosted primary hit to distinct eligible secondary enemies; the follow-up is not a second activation and cannot hit the primary again.

path2.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase adds a bounded follow-up to the temporary peak, giving the single placed capstone a burst behavior unavailable from additional fourth-purchase copies. The boost remains attached to the purchased Rhitta attack and does not grant invulnerability.

Proposed early purchases: x-x-1 increases the range of Escanor's ordinary Rhitta attack without changing its delivery or target capacity. x-x-2 further increases ordinary attack range while keeping the same single-targeting choice and attack delivery.

path3.name: Controlled Solar Heat
path3.buyFor: Choose this path when nearby groups can be reached by impact splash and eligible enemies benefit from sustained heat damage.
path3.weakness: Splash remains centered on enemies hit by the ordinary attack, does not extend attack range, and burn refreshes rather than stacking; immune enemies are not excluded by invented damage access.

milestones.tier1: x-x-1 increases the range of Escanor's ordinary Rhitta attack without changing its delivery or target capacity.
milestones.tier2: x-x-2 further increases ordinary attack range while keeping the same single-targeting choice and attack delivery.
milestones.tier3: x-x-3 adapts Cruel Sun's nearby heat as splash damage around the enemy hit by the ordinary attack; the splash does not increase range or hit enemies beyond its defined area.
milestones.tier4: x-x-4 adds a bounded burn to enemies damaged by the ordinary Rhitta hit and its splash, representing Escanor's heat-imbued axe; a fresh application refreshes the status rather than stacking it.
milestones.tier5: x-x-5 adapts Crazy Prominence's exploding miniature suns as a wider bounded splash on the existing attack and its existing burn application; it does not spawn independent suns or separate projectiles.

path3.capstoneValue: The fifth purchase adds a distinct, bounded area footprint to the heat attack, rather than only raising burn or damage. The single placed capstone can cover more nearby enemies per attack, while extra fourth-purchase copies only add the existing burn.

Proposed early purchases: x-1-x represents Sunshine's rising physical speed by increasing the ordinary Rhitta attack rate without changing its delivery. x-2-x further increases the ordinary attack rate as Sunshine's power rises, retaining the same single-projectile Rhitta strike.

omittedTechniques.name: Pride Flare
omittedTechniques.reason: Escanor flares Cruel Sun with heat intense enough to vaporize a sizable lake in an instant. The Definition has no instant-vaporization or lake-scale destruction behavior; ordinary splash and burn can approximate heat but do not carry this technique's defining instantaneous, extreme-scale effect, and no purchase mechanic represents that effect.

omittedTechniques.name: Final Prominence
omittedTechniques.reason: The source's defining effect is hurling a gigantic swirling fireball, a distinct thrown delivery. The Definition cannot express a separate attack delivery within the one-attack boost, and the supported boost and splash do not carry that central delivery.

omittedTechniques.name: Divine Sword Escanor
omittedTechniques.reason: The technique's defining behavior includes a hand-swipe that destroys Ominous Nebula. The Definition has no dispel or equivalent interaction, and ordinary axe damage does not reproduce that central effect.

omittedTechniques.name: Divine Spear Escanor
omittedTechniques.reason: The source describes a forceful finger thrust that pierces an opponent. The Definition's pierce is enemy hit capacity, not penetration, and no supported delivery change produces the technique's central finger-thrust behavior.

omittedTechniques.name: Daytime
omittedTechniques.reason: The source's defining behavior is Escanor's changing body and power as the sun rises, including the progression from frail to larger and stronger. A permanent stat purchase sequence does not carry its time-dependent transformation, and the Definition has no clock or transformation mechanic; the plan adapts some increasing strength separately but does not implement Daytime itself.

omittedTechniques.name: Night-time
omittedTechniques.reason: Night-time weakness and inability to use magic require a time-of-day state absent from the Definition. A stat reduction without that trigger would not adapt the technique's defining condition.

omittedTechniques.name: The One: Ultimate
omittedTechniques.reason: Its defining extension sustains and enhances The One by consuming Escanor's life force and eventually killing him. The Definition has no self-health cost or death behavior, and an ordinary attack boost cannot represent that central sacrifice.

omittedTechniques.name: Large Spear
omittedTechniques.reason: The cited evidence documents a period-specific possession but no attack behavior. There is no source-described combat effect to adapt.

omittedTechniques.name: Magic Glasses
omittedTechniques.reason: The glasses suppress and release Escanor's daytime form through equipment removal. The Definition has no equipment toggle or transformation trigger, and ordinary attack changes would not carry this central interaction.

scopeLimits: This is a proposal based only on the selected passages, not an exhaustive repertoire or independent canon verification.

Sunshine's story-period transfers are retained: Escanor returned it to Mael during the New Holy War, then received it back for the Demon King battle. The plan does not claim continuous availability across every period.
No real-time sunrise, noon, sunset, or nighttime state is implemented. The One is represented only as a temporary attack boost, not as invulnerability or a guaranteed one-minute form.
Rhitta recall, its instant stored-heat release as a separate action, the independent miniature suns, and the thrown fireball delivery are not represented as separate attacks.

All numbers, prices, status magnitudes, status durations, boost windows, cooldowns, and balance outcomes are unspecified proposals for the Definition and playtesting; no execution or balance is claimed.
